title: Permission rules (mpi-permission)
description: Gate tool calls with allow / ask / deny rules. Keys are tool names, "*", or "external_directory"; values are one action or an ordered pattern->action object where the last matching rule wins. "doom_loop" takes an action only.

action.description: allow: run without approval; ask: prompt for approval; deny: block the call.

anyOf.description: Ordered wildcard rules over the tool's subject (* = any chars, ? = one char, leading ~ or $HOME expands). Last matching rule wins; put "*" first.

doom_loop.description: Fires when the same tool is called with identical input 3 times in a row. Action string only; absent = off.
